lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ذ/هـ/ب   dh–h–b gold
; to go, to go away, to set out; to take away; creed, faction, sect, to adopt as a conviction.

Of this root, 5 forms occur 56 times in the Qur’an:
ذَهَبَ dhahaba 35 times; أَذْهَبَ ʾadhhaba 11 times; ذَاهِبٌ dhāhib 1 time; ذَهَابٌ dhahāb 1 time and ذَهَبٌ dhahab 8 times.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
ذَهَبَ dhahaba a [v. intrans.]

1 to go

(20:97) قَالَ فَاذْهَبْ he said ‘Go!’

2 to go off

(21:87) وَذَا النُّونِ إِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا and [remember] Dhū’l‐Nūn [Jonah] when he went off angrily

3 to disappear, to clear off, to vanish

(33:19) فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُمْ بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ but when fear has passed, they lash at you with sharp tongues

4 [with prep. عَن] to go from, to depart from, to leave

(11:10) لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّئَاتُ عَنِّي he is sure to say, ‘Misfortune has gone away from me’

5 [with prep, بِـ] a) to go away with

(2:17) ذَهَبَ اللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِى ظُلُمَاتٍ لاَ يُبْصِرُونَ God took away their light, leaving them in utter darkness, unable to see; b) to claim, to appropriate for oneself

(23:91) وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِذًا لَذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلاَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ nor is there any god with Him–if there were, each god would have claimed his creation, and some of them would have tried to overcome the others.

entries.label: ذ-هـ-ب
entries.definitionHtml:
ذ/هـ/ب   dh–h–b gold
; to go, to go away, to set out; to take away; creed, faction, sect, to adopt as a conviction.

Of this root, 5 forms occur 56 times in the Qur’an:
ذَهَبَ dhahaba 35 times; أَذْهَبَ ʾadhhaba 11 times; ذَاهِبٌ dhāhib 1 time; ذَهَابٌ dhahāb 1 time and ذَهَبٌ dhahab 8 times.

entries.label: ذَهَبَ
entries.definitionHtml:
ذَهَبَ dhahaba a [v. intrans.]

1 to go

(20:97) قَالَ فَاذْهَبْ he said ‘Go!’

2 to go off

(21:87) وَذَا النُّونِ إِذْ ذَهَبَ مُغَاضِبًا and [remember] Dhū’l‐Nūn [Jonah] when he went off angrily

3 to disappear, to clear off, to vanish

(33:19) فَإِذَا ذَهَبَ الْخَوْفُ سَلَقُوكُمْ بِأَلْسِنَةٍ حِدَادٍ but when fear has passed, they lash at you with sharp tongues

4 [with prep. عَن] to go from, to depart from, to leave

(11:10) لَيَقُولَنَّ ذَهَبَ السَّيِّئَاتُ عَنِّي he is sure to say, ‘Misfortune has gone away from me’

5 [with prep, بِـ] a) to go away with

(2:17) ذَهَبَ اللَّهُ بِنُورِهِمْ وَتَرَكَهُمْ فِى ظُلُمَاتٍ لاَ يُبْصِرُونَ God took away their light, leaving them in utter darkness, unable to see; b) to claim, to appropriate for oneself

(23:91) وَمَا كَانَ مَعَهُ مِنْ إِلَهٍ إِذًا لَذَهَبَ كُلُّ إِلَهٍ بِمَا خَلَقَ وَلَعَلاَ بَعْضُهُمْ عَلَى بَعْضٍ nor is there any god with Him–if there were, each god would have claimed his creation, and some of them would have tried to overcome the others.

entries.label: أَذْهَبَ
entries.definitionHtml:
أَذْهَبَ ʾadhhaba [v. IV, trans.]

1 to remove

(9:15) وَيُذْهِبْ غَيْظَ قُلُوبِهِمْ and remove the rage from their hearts

2 to cause to disappear, to cause to vanish

(4:133) إِنْ يَشَأْ يُذْهِبْكُمْ أَيُّهَا النَّاسُ وَيَأْتِ بِآخَرِينَ if He so willed, He could make you, humankind, vanish and replace you with others.

entries.label: ذَاهِبٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
ذَاهِبٌ dhāhib [act. part.] one going

(37:99) إِنِّي ذَاهِبٌ إِلَى رَبِّي سَيَهْدِينِ I am going to my Lord: He will surely guide me.

entries.label: ذَهَابٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
ذَهَابٌ dhahāb [v. n., with prep.ﺒِ] the act of taking away, abolishing

(23:18) وَإِنَّا عَلَى ذَهَابٍ بِهِ لَقَادِرُونَ and for taking it all away We are able.

entries.label: ذَهَبٌ
entries.definitionHtml:
ذَهَبٌ dhahab [coll. n.] gold

(9:34) وَالَّذِينَ يَكْنِزُونَ الذَّهَبَ وَالْفِضَّةَ those who hoard gold and silver.
